_comment: Arcade build. Every character on this roster is vendored beside the game, Fat Chad included: his 41 MiB Mixamo FBX was three 4096px maps on an unindexed mesh, not geometry, so re-exported at 1024px with the vertices welded he is a 2 MiB GLB and inside Cloudflare's per-asset limit. Model URLs still resolve bucket-first and fall back to this folder — TRENCHSTAR_ASSETS in index.html points at the bucket — so anything not up there costs one failed lookup and nothing else. Lady Luck's own walk was a 19 MB 'With Skin' Mixamo download whose duplicate mesh is discarded on load anyway, so she borrows the donor rig's like everyone else. xbot.glb and soldier.glb are the donor rigs every borrowed walk and idle comes from: deliberately off this roster, never playable, and both files stay here regardless.
